title: Patient Invoices & Statements Cash Posting and Returned Payment Standard
content:
A payment on a Patient Invoices & Statements invoice is accepted only by a method on the billing class's list of accepted payment methods, and no card convenience fee is charged for it.

## Standards

**Standard 1 — Method.** Payments are accepted only by a method in the billing class's accepted payment methods, with no card convenience fee charged.

**Standard 2 — Posting time.** A payment posts to the invoice within the billing class's posting time, in business days, of receipt.

**Standard 3 — Part payments.** A part payment, meaning a payment of less than the balance due, is accepted only where the billing class accepts part payments. A part payment does not stop the statement cycle.

**Standard 4 — Payable statuses.** A payment can be applied only to an invoice whose status is open, on hold, payment plan or collections. The status that counts is the one on that invoice's own record at the time the payment is applied.

**Standard 5 — Reversals.** A payment returned unpaid or charged back is reversed in full, and a paid invoice becomes due again. For a returned check or an ACH return, the billing class's returned-payment fee is posted when it is above 0.00.

## Payable statuses

| Invoice status | Payment can be applied |
|---|---|
| Open | Yes |
| On hold | Yes |
| Payment plan | Yes |
| Collections | Yes |
| Paid | No |
| Closed | No |

## Reversal reasons on the record

| Reason recorded on the reversal | Payment reversed | Returned-payment fee |
|---|---|---|
| Returned check | In full | Posted when the class fee is above 0.00 |
| ACH return | In full | Posted when the class fee is above 0.00 |
| Card chargeback | In full | Not among the reasons the fee is tied to |

## Illustration (hypothetical invoice and amounts)

A Patient Invoices & Statements invoice of 180.00 is settled by a check of 180.00 and its status becomes paid. The check is later returned unpaid. The payment of 180.00 is reversed in full, and on a class whose returned-payment fee is 25.00 that fee is posted as well, so 205.00 is due and the invoice is due again. On a class whose returned-payment fee is 0.00 no fee is posted and 180.00 is due again.
